maximum_rise_fall_contract: max_up_pips, max_down_pips, max_up_ts, and max_down_ts cover release_ts through T+60 minutes inclusive.

pre_release_anchor_contract.market_closed: UNAVAILABLE; do not substitute a later opening price.
pre_release_anchor_contract.rule: Use the close of the latest accepted USD/JPY candle at or before release_ts. The timestamp is UTC and may be no more than 60 seconds stale; otherwise Outcome is UNAVAILABLE. This replaces v2.0's reaction-detected anchor because v2.1 evaluates the path from the scheduled catalyst release.

reversal_contract: initial_direction is direction_5m when directional, otherwise the first directional value at 15, 30, or 60 minutes, otherwise FLAT. reversal_flag is true when the earliest later required horizon is opposite to initial_direction; reversal_ts is exactly that release_ts plus horizon. No free-form reversal interpretation is allowed.
zero_leakage_rule: no outcome collection before authorization activation and earliest valid collection time
